title: Design, synthesis, biological evaluation and docking analysis of pyrrolidine-benzenesulfonamides as carbonic anhydrase or acetylcholinesterase inhibitors and antimicrobial agents.
authors: Poyraz, Samet; Dondas, H Ali; Yamali, Cem; Belveren, Samet; Demir, Yeliz; Aydinoglu, Sabriye; Dondas, Naciye Yaktubay; Taskin-Tok, Tugba; Tas, Senanur; Ulger, Mahmut; Sansano, Jose M
one_liner_zh: 该文主要研究吡咯烷苯磺酰胺类化合物作为碳酸酐酶/乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂及抗菌剂的合成与活性，仅附带DNA结合效应和针对酶的分子对接，非蛋白质-DNA互作核心体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The synthesis and biological assessment of novel multi-functionalized pyrrolidine-containing benzenesulfonamides were reported along with their antimicrobial, antifungal, CAs inhibition, and AChE inhibition as well as DNA-binding effects. The chemical structure of the compounds was elucidated by using FTIR, NMR, and HRMS. Compound 3b, which had Ki values of 17.61 +/- 3.58 nM (hCA I) and 5.14 +/- 0.61 nM (hCA II), was found the be the most potent CAs inhibitor. Compounds 6a and 6b showed remarkable AChE inhibition effects with Ki values 22.34 +/- 4.53 nM and 27.21 +/- 3.96 nM in comparison to tacrine. Compounds 6a-6c had moderate antituberculosis effect on M. tuberculosis with a MIC value of 15.62 mug/ml. Compounds had weaker antifungal and antibacterial activity in the range of MIC 500-62.5 mug/ml against standard bacterial and fungal strains. Besides these above, molecular docking studies were performed to examine and evaluate the interaction of the remarkable compounds (3b, 6a and 6b) against the current enzymes (CAs and AChE). Novel compounds gained interest in terms of enzyme inhibitory potencies. Therefore, the most potent enzyme inhibitors may be considered lead compounds to be modified for further research.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 本文报道了新型多功能含吡咯烷苯磺酰胺的合成及其生物评估，包括其抗菌、抗真菌、碳酸酐酶（CAs）抑制、乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）抑制以及DNA结合效应。通过FTIR、NMR和HRMS阐明了化合物的化学结构。化合物3b对hCA I和hCA II的Ki值分别为17.61 ± 3.58 nM和5.14 ± 0.61 nM，被发现是最有效的CAs抑制剂。与他克林相比，化合物6a和6b表现出显著的AChE抑制效果，其Ki值分别为22.34 ± 4.53 nM和27.21 ± 3.96 nM。化合物6a-6c对结核分枝杆菌具有中等抗结核作用，MIC值为15.62 μg/ml。这些化合物对标准细菌和真菌菌株的抗菌和抗真菌活性较弱，MIC范围在500-62.5 μg/ml之间。此外，进行了分子对接研究，以检查和评估显著化合物（3b、6a和6b）与当前酶（CAs和AChE）的相互作用。新型化合物在酶抑制效力方面引起了关注。因此，最有效的酶抑制剂可被视为先导化合物，以供进一步研究修饰。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
